title: Ultimate+ 2.26.0: live video and sound between your devices
summary: The latest release of Ultimate+, 2.26.0 (build 148), turns Watch camera in Octopus Mesh into a live video and sound call. 2.25.0, earlier the same evening, added still-picture camera sharing.
whyCare: If you already have the app on more than one device, you can try lending a camera to the others. The live call itself has not yet been tried on two real phones.
limitations: The 2.26.0 notes say live video and sound have not yet been tried with two real devices (smoothness, delay, battery, heat, or connecting across networks). This site has not independently built or run the app.
